name: one_prime_first_order
summary: Take F = T·B(−v)·U with T, U the sums of ρ over coset representatives and their inverses and v the least absolute residue. Conjugating by the representatives turns sums over H into sums over Γ (key); with hΨ and hX this gives (Σρ)ΨB(1) = n·T·B(1), whence (i) with Z_g built from the H-components of g·η̂, and L·Z_g = 0 by tf. For (ii), the weight f(x) = −v(x)(v(x)+k) has f(x−k) − f(x) ≡ 2k·v(x); conjugation sums weights over the cosets into the transfer, and k·Tr_a(γ) = k closes the computation modulo m.

steps.claim: Let T = Σ_{η∈Γ/H} ρ(η̂), η̂ the chosen representative of the coset η.
steps.lean: let T := ∑ η : Γ ⧸ H, ρ η.out
let U := ∑ η : Γ ⧸ H, ρ η.out⁻¹

steps.claim: Let v : ℤ/m → ℤ send a residue to its representative of least absolute value.
For g, x ∈ Γ let w(g, x) = r⁻¹·gx ∈ H, r the chosen representative of the coset gxH: the component in H of gx with respect to the representatives.
steps.lean:
-- the component in H with respect to the representatives
  let w (g x : Γ) : H := ⟨_, QuotientGroup.eq.1 (g • x : Γ ⧸ H).out_eq⟩

steps.claim: For every f : H → ℤ and x ∈ Γ: T·(Σ_{p∈H} f(p)ρ(p))·ρ(x⁻¹) = Σ_{g∈Γ} f(w(g, x))ρ(g); expand the product into a double sum over (η, p) and substitute the bijection (η, p) ↦ η̂ p x⁻¹, whose inverse is g ↦ (coset of gx, w(g, x)).
steps.lean:
have key (f : H → ℤ) x : T * (∑ p, f p • ρ p) * ρ x⁻¹ = ∑ g, f (w g x) • ρ g := by
    rw [sum_mul_sum, ← sum_product', sum_mul, sum_nbij' (fun (η, p) ↦ η.out * p * x⁻¹)
      fun g ↦ (↑(g * x), w g x)] <;> simp [w]
steps.typed_fact: T * (∑ p, f p • ρ p) * ρ x⁻¹ = ∑ g, f (w g x) • ρ g

steps.claim: (Σ_{g∈Γ} ρ(g))·(Ψ·B(1)) = n·T·B(1): multiply hΨ by T on the left and B(1) on the right, use hX (ρ(p)B(1) = B(1)), substitute p ↦ p⁻¹ in H, and use step 5 with f = 1, x = 1 (T·Σ_{p∈H} ρ(p) = Σ_{g∈Γ} ρ(g)).
steps.lean:
have e : (∑ g, ρ g) * (Ψ * B 1) = n • T * B 1 := by simpa [← by simpa using key 1 1, hX, ←
    (Equiv.sum_comp (.inv H) (ρ ·)), sum_mul, mul_assoc, ← nsmul_eq_mul] using congr(T * $hΨ * B 1)

use T * B (-v) * U, by grind [mul_mem, sum_mem], fun g ↦ ⟨Ψ * B 1 * ∑ η : Γ ⧸ H,
    v (a (w g η.out)).toAdd • ρ η.out⁻¹, ?_, by simp [← mul_assoc, @tf _ 0
    (by simpa [T, mul_sum, ← mul_assoc, hL, h, -nsmul_eq_mul] using congr(L * $e))]⟩,
    fun h₁ h₂ ↦ .trans ?_ (congr(-σ $(h₂ ((2 * k) • v))).trans ?_)

steps.claim: F ∈ 𝒜: the ρ(g) and B(−v) lie in 𝒜 (hρ, h𝒜), which is closed under sums and products.
For g ∈ Γ take Z_g = Ψ·B(1)·Σ_{η∈Γ/H} v(a(w(g, η̂)))·ρ(η̂⁻¹); its first property is step 8.
steps.lean:
fun g ↦ ⟨Ψ * B 1 * ∑ η : Γ ⧸ H,
    v (a (w g η.out)).toAdd • ρ η.out⁻¹, ?_,

steps.claim: L·Z_g = 0: multiplying step 6 by L on the left, hL gives L·(Σρ) = |Γ|·L and L·T = [Γ:H]·L, and h gives L·B(1) = 0; so |Γ|·(L·Ψ·B(1)) = 0, and L·Ψ·B(1) = 0 because |Γ| is regular on R (tf).
steps.lean:
by simp [← mul_assoc, @tf _ 0
    (by simpa [T, mul_sum, ← mul_assoc, hL, h, -nsmul_eq_mul] using congr(L * $e))]⟩,

steps.claim: For (ii), given the two hypotheses h₁ and h₂ the identity is the chain (2k)·σ(F)σ(ac(t)) = −σ(weightedSum(ρ, Tr_a)((2k)v)·ac(t')) (step 9) = −σ((ρ(γ) − 1)·weightedSum(ρ, Tr_a)((2k)v)·r) (h₂ for f = (2k)v) = (2k)·σ(Σρ)σ(r) (step 10).

steps.lean:
· rw [← mul_assoc, e, mul_sub, mul_assoc, sum_mul _ _ (ρ g), ← Fintype.sum_equiv (toPerm
      g) (fun η ↦ ρ (w g η.out * η.out⁻¹)) _ (by simp [w, mul_assoc])]
    simp [mul_sum, mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc (B _), hB, sub_mul, mul_sub, U, v, fun y ↦
      map_eq_of_weights_modEq σ hm B (v <| · - y) (v - v y • 1)]

steps.claim: By step 6, (Σρ)·Z_g = n·T·B(1)·Σ_η v(a(w(g, η̂)))ρ(η̂⁻¹); on the other side expand F·ρ(g) = T·B(−v)·Σ_η ρ(η̂⁻¹g) and substitute along the permutation of Γ/H induced by g, writing η̂⁻¹g as w(g, η̂)·(representative)⁻¹.
steps.lean:
rw [← mul_assoc, e, mul_sub, mul_assoc, sum_mul _ _ (ρ g), ← Fintype.sum_equiv (toPerm
      g) (fun η ↦ ρ (w g η.out * η.out⁻¹)) _ (by simp [w, mul_assoc])]

steps.claim: Each B(−v)·ρ(w) with w ∈ H equals B(x ↦ −v(x − a(w))) (hB), and after σ this is σ(B(−v)) + v(a(w))·σ(B(1)) because v(x − y) ≡ v(x) − v(y) mod m and σ kills m (map_eq_of_weights_modEq); the terms σ(B(−v)) cancel against −F and the rest is n·T·B(1)·Σ_η v(a(w(g, η̂)))ρ(η̂⁻¹).
steps.lean:
simp [mul_sum, mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc (B _), hB, sub_mul, mul_sub, U, v, fun y ↦
      map_eq_of_weights_modEq σ hm B (v <| · - y) (v - v y • 1)]

· have e₂ : σ (T * weightedSum (ρ.comp H.subtype) a v * U) = σ (weightedSum ρ a.transfer v) := by
      -- conjugating by the representatives sums the weights over the cosets
      erw [mul_sum, funext fun _ ↦ key .., ← map_sum (Fintype.linearCombination ..).toAddMonoidHom]
      apply map_eq_of_weights_modEq σ hm; simp [v, diff, fun g ↦ a.transfer_def (g⁻¹ • default) g,
        mul_assoc, smul_apply_eq_smul_apply_inv_smul, leftQuotientEquiv_apply _]; congr!; simp
    -- small orders: the weight a (a + k) and its translate (a - k) a differ by 2 k a
    simpa (disch := simp_intro x [v]; ring) [← e₂, mul_assoc, (@hc U (sum_mem (by tauto)) _).eq,
      -map_sub, -nsmul_eq_mul, map_eq_of_weights_modEq σ hm _ _ ((2 * k) • v)]
      using congr(σ (T * $(h₁ fun x ↦ -v x * (v x + k)) * U))

steps.claim: σ(T·weightedSum(ρ|_H, a)(v)·U) = σ(weightedSum(ρ, Tr_a)(v)): by step 5 the left side is σ of Σ_{g∈Γ} (Σ_η v(a(w(g, η̂))))ρ(g), and Σ_η a(w(g, η̂)) is the transfer Tr_a(g) (its defining product over the cosets), so the integer weights agree modulo m and σ identifies the two (map_eq_of_weights_modEq).
steps.lean:
have e₂ : σ (T * weightedSum (ρ.comp H.subtype) a v * U) = σ (weightedSum ρ a.transfer v) := by
      -- conjugating by the representatives sums the weights over the cosets
      erw [mul_sum, funext fun _ ↦ key .., ← map_sum (Fintype.linearCombination ..).toAddMonoidHom]
      apply map_eq_of_weights_modEq σ hm; simp [v, diff, fun g ↦ a.transfer_def (g⁻¹ • default) g,
        mul_assoc, smul_apply_eq_smul_apply_inv_smul, leftQuotientEquiv_apply _]; congr!; simp
steps.typed_fact: σ (T * weightedSum (ρ.comp H.subtype) a v * U) = σ (weightedSum ρ a.transfer v)

steps.claim: Apply h₁ to f(x) = −v(x)(v(x) + k): then f(x − k) − f(x) ≡ 2k·v(x) mod m (as v(x − k) ≡ v(x) − k), so after σ: B((2k)v)·ac(t) = weightedSum(ρ|_H, a)((2k)v)·ac(t'). Multiply by T on the left and U on the right, move ac(t) past U (hc, U ∈ 𝒜) and use 9.1 and F = T·B(−v)·U.
steps.lean:
-- small orders: the weight a (a + k) and its translate (a - k) a differ by 2 k a
    simpa (disch := simp_intro x [v]; ring) [← e₂, mul_assoc, (@hc U (sum_mem (by tauto)) _).eq,
      -map_sub, -nsmul_eq_mul, map_eq_of_weights_modEq σ hm _ _ ((2 * k) • v)]
      using congr(σ (T * $(h₁ fun x ↦ -v x * (v x + k)) * U))

steps.claim: Last link of (ii): −σ((ρ(γ) − 1)·weightedSum(ρ, Tr_a)((2k)v)·r) = (2k)·σ(Σρ)σ(r): by mul_weightedSum, ρ(γ)·weightedSum(ρ, Tr_a)(f) = weightedSum(ρ, Tr_a)(f(· − Tr_a(γ))); the weights (2k)(v(x − Tr_a(γ)) − v(x)) are ≡ −2k·Tr_a(γ) ≡ −2k mod m by hn, so the difference is σ(−2k·Σ_g ρ(g)).
steps.lean:
rw [sub_one_mul, mul_weightedSum, ← map_sub, map_mul, map_eq_of_weights_modEq σ hm _ _ (-2 *
    k)] <;> simp [weightedSum, v, ← mul_sum, mul_sub, mul_assoc, @zsmul_eq_mul S, hn]
